arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math

# Seigniorage on coins (silver and minor) - from Table 5, cumulative from January 1, 1935
# Values are in millions of dollars
V_1945 = 429.5  # End of CY 1945
V_1955 = 807.0  # End of CY 1955

# Number of years
T = 1955 - 1945  # = 10 years

# Continuously compounded average annual growth rate
# V2 = V1 * e^(r*T)
# r = ln(V2/V1) / T
r = math.log(V_1955 / V_1945) / T

print(f'V_1945 = {V_1945} million dollars')
print(f'V_1955 = {V_1955} million dollars')
print(f'T = {T} years')
print(f'V_1955 / V_1945 = {V_1955 / V_1945}')
print(f'ln(V_1955 / V_1945) = {math.log(V_1955 / V_1945)}')
print(f'Continuously compounded CAGR = {r}')
print(f'Rounded to 3 decimal places = {round(r, 3)}')
"
